svg.title: Water reabsorption from collecting duct into medullary blood capillaries
svg.desc: Schematic section showing filtrate descending in the collecting duct through a more concentrated medulla. More ADH adds aquaporins, increasing water permeability; water moves by osmosis across medullary interstitial fluid into adjacent capillary blood. The loop of Henle helps establish the gradient. Not to scale.
svg.text: Water reabsorption: collecting duct, medulla and blood
Biology • water reabsorption and osmoregulation • schematic, not to scale
helps build the medullary ion gradient
More ADH → more aquaporins → higher permeability; water moves by osmosis. ADH does not pump water.
Marlbridge • Biology study resource • teaching diagram
Water passes from filtrate, through medullary tissue, into nearby capillary blood.
